policy.description: Keep OrcaTeal on upstream stable releases and carry only workflow-critical Teal patches that are not upstream.
policy.requiredTopology: Air Raid UI -> Ultra Magnus runtime -> fleet SSH hosts
policy.forbiddenTopology: Air Raid UI -> Ultra Magnus runtime -> Air Raid SSH
policy.upstreamReviewRule: Every rebase must run verify:teal-patch-stack against the new stable tag. Exact upstream equivalents require an explicit keep/drop decision before release.
